name: Mercenary Stunning Blows
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Stunning Blows (players/paladin/mercenary/stunning_blows_merc.sval, 12 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): chance 20% (25%); triggers on any class's primary attack. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Any primary attack, not just the Sword, has a 20% chance to stun for 2.5 s.
